# testdata

Reference OOXML files used by the roundtrip harness (`scripts/roundtrip.sh`) and the format crates.

**Provisional files are NOT authoritative for "opens in MS Office" claims.** They are produced by
LibreOffice and only prove that LibreOffice can read them. Replace them with real Office-authored
files as soon as those are available. Regenerate with `scripts/gen-testdata.sh` (sources in
`scripts/testdata-src/`), check with `scripts/gen-testdata.sh --verify`.

| File | Origin | Contents |
|------|--------|----------|
| `docx/provisional-basic.docx` | LibreOffice 25.2 headless – PROVISIONAL, replace with real Office file | Title, Heading 1, Heading 2, three body paragraphs with bold/italic/underline and one red run, 3-item bulleted list, 3-item numbered list, 3x3 table with header row, one centered and one right-aligned paragraph |
| `docx/provisional-image.docx` | LibreOffice 25.2 headless – PROVISIONAL, replace with real Office file | One paragraph, one paragraph with an inline 64x64 PNG (3 cm square) |
| `xlsx/provisional-basic.xlsx` | LibreOffice 25.2 headless – PROVISIONAL, replace with real Office file | Sheets `Data` and `Summary`. `Data`: bold header (Item/Qty/Price/Total/Date/Active), 5 rows, `B*C` formulas, `SUM`, `AVERAGE`, `IF`, a date and a boolean cell, yellow fill, thin border, `0.00` and `#,##0` formats. `Summary`: cross-sheet `=Data!D7` plus a text cell |
| `xlsx/provisional-types.xlsx` | LibreOffice 25.2 headless – PROVISIONAL, replace with real Office file | Sheet `Types`: empty cell, integer, negative, decimal, 1e15, text, text `0123`, TRUE/FALSE, date, time, percentage, error `=1/0` |
| `xlsx/provisional-chart-combo.xlsx` | openpyxl 3.1.5 – PROVISIONAL, replace with real Excel file | Sheet `Sales` (Month/Revenue/Profit, 6 rows): clustered column (Revenue) + line (Profit) combo with chart title, axis titles and a bottom legend (one-cell anchor at E2) |
| `xlsx/provisional-chart-pie.xlsx` | openpyxl 3.1.5 – PROVISIONAL, replace with real Excel file | Sheet `Share` (Region/Units): pie with category + percent data labels; doughnut with 60 % hole and a right legend |
| `xlsx/provisional-chart-mixed.xlsx` | openpyxl 3.1.5 – PROVISIONAL, replace with real Excel file | Sheet `Data` (X/Y1/Y2/Q1/Q2): smooth scatter (style 13, Y axis 0..8 step 2), stacked bar, stacked area, column + line on a secondary axis |
| `xlsx/provisional-comments.xlsx` | openpyxl 3.1.5 + hand-built threaded parts – PROVISIONAL, replace with real Excel file | Sheets `Review`, `Totals`: notes by `Ann Lee` (A2) and `Bob` (B3, 200 × 100 px box), hyperlinks to a web page (C2), an e-mail with subject (C3) and `Totals!A1` with a ScreenTip (C4), a threaded comment with a reply (A4) and a resolved one (B4) with Excel's legacy placeholders and the person list |
| `xlsx/provisional-pivot-basic.xlsx` | openpyxl 3.1.5 + pivot parts from Rusuite's writer – PROVISIONAL, replace with real Excel file | Sheets `Data` (Region/Product/Qtr/Sales/Units, 6 rows) and `Pivot`: a compact pivot table at A3 (rows Region, columns Qtr, Sum of Sales, grand totals); LibreOffice 25.2 opens it as a data pilot table |
| `xlsx/provisional-pivot-tabular.xlsx` | openpyxl 3.1.5 + pivot parts from Rusuite's writer – PROVISIONAL, replace with real Excel file | Same `Data`; `Pivot`: a tabular pivot table at A1 with page field Qtr = Q2, rows Region › Product with subtotals, Sum of Sales and Count of Units; LibreOffice 25.2 opens it as a data pilot table |

The chart workbooks are generated by `python3 -I scripts/testdata-src/xlsx/charts.py testdata/xlsx`
(the comments workbook by `scripts/testdata-src/xlsx/comments.py`, the pivot workbooks by `scripts/testdata-src/xlsx/pivot.py`)
(openpyxl, see `docs/setup.md`); openpyxl writes no reference caches, so they also test that the
writer computes them.
| `pptx/provisional-basic.pptx` | LibreOffice 25.2 headless – PROVISIONAL, replace with real Office file | Slide 1 title + subtitle; slide 2 title + 3 bullets; slide 3 rectangle, ellipse and a text box |

### docx reference suite (`docx/provisional-NN-*.docx`) - PROVISIONAL

50 small documents (one feature topic each, combinations in 47-50) generated by LibreOffice 25.2 headless; **replace with Word-authored files**. `docx/manifest.json` lists per file the topic, a feature list and the paragraph count; vocabulary and workflow in `docs/docx-suite.md`. Regenerate with `scripts/gen-docx-suite.sh` (sources in `scripts/testdata-src/docx/`), check with `--verify`.

### pptx reference suite (`pptx/provisional-NN-*.pptx`) - PROVISIONAL

25 small decks (one feature topic each, combinations in 22 and 25) generated by LibreOffice 25.2 headless; **replace with PowerPoint-authored files**. `pptx/manifest.json` lists per file the topic and a feature list; vocabulary and workflow in `docs/pptx-suite.md`. Regenerate with `scripts/gen-pptx-suite.sh` (sources in `scripts/testdata-src/pptx/`), check with `--verify`.

### Formula reference suite (`formulas/`) - PROVISIONAL

Expected values were computed by LibreOffice 25.2 headless and **must be replaced by Excel-computed values** (workflow in `docs/formula-suite.md`). Regenerate with `scripts/gen-formula-suite.sh` (source in `scripts/testdata-src/formulas.*`), check with `--verify`; formulas are evaluated on sheet `Data`.

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `formulas/fixture.tsv` | Fixture grid (sheets `Data`, `Other`): `sheet, cell, type, value` |
| `formulas/{math,logical,info,text,lookup,datetime,operators,references,errors}.tsv` | 862 cases `formula, type, expected, note` - PROVISIONAL (LibreOffice values; rows with `DIFF:` notes are known to differ from Excel) |
| `formulas/formula-suite.xlsx` | Same cases as a workbook (formulas in `Data!L`, text in `Data!K`); open in Excel, recalc, send back for `--from-xlsx` |

The function list the suite covers is `docs/functions.md`. `*/out/` holds harness output and is git-ignored.
